about: Kurt HDL6AL two-station 6 in vise: one CAD mesh in 7 solids, no colours, the body welded to its jaws. By height and facing: the ductile-iron body in Kurt blue, its ways ground, everything above the bed (z 79.4 mm) the machinable aluminium jaws, the screw and pins steel.

rules.why: the bed's ways and the stations' floors: up-facing at z 77-80 mm, ground
the machinable aluminium jaws: everything above the bed
the thin plates on the stations' floors (parts 0, 2)
the lead screw and its hex (part 3)
pins and screws at the handle end (parts 4-6)

vise6_alu_jaw.about: Kurt's 1.735 in machinable aluminium jaws: milled 6061

unsure.what: the body's paint: Kurt blue assumed on every non-ground body face, as on Kurt's other vises; the HDL6's sides may be ground bare
